name: pro
description: Doña Billetes, a middle-aged Bolivian woman boss for a 16-bit beat em up: dark hair with grey streaks pulled back in a low ponytail, stern annoyed face, blue denim jacket with chest pockets (a few banknotes peeking out of the pockets), dark navy t-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers. Full body, side view facing right, standing in a confident fighting-ready stance, arms slightly bent. Same pixel art style, proportions and outline as the style reference character. Transparent background, single character, no text, no shadow, no effects.
